description: Turn Mermaid diagram text into a hosted PNG and SVG image URL (cached on a CDN). Use it when a diagram has to go somewhere that cannot run Mermaid: email, Slack or Teams messages, PDFs, Word/Google Docs, Confluence, WhatsApp, a README. Returns the URLs plus ready-made Markdown and HTML. Free — no AI credits.

mermaid.description: Mermaid source, e.g. "flowchart TD\n  A[Start] --> B{OK?}"

style.description: "aiflowchart" (default) draws it in AI Flowchart's polished board style; "mermaid" gives the classic Mermaid look. Unsupported diagram types fall back to classic automatically.

name: render_diagram
title: Render Mermaid as an image
